about: Tools the harness runs itself for API steps (Gemini). Each step in steps.json names the ones it may use, and only those schemas are sent. Every call goes through guard.py first, with the step's read roots.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files under a folder of the project, one relative path per line.

path.description: Folder relative to the project root. Default: the root.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from the project.

path.description: File relative to the project root.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find lines matching a regular expression in the project's text files.

path.description: Folder to search, relative to the project root. Default: the root.

tools.name: read_skill_reference
tools.description: Read a reference file from one of this repo's skills, such as tuning numbers or examples.

file.description: Path inside the skill folder, for example references/tuning.md.
